mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reembed_job (id, from_model_id, to_model_id, from_dimension, to_dimension, status, total_count, processed_count, failed_count, error_message, operator, started_at, finished_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{fromModelId}, #{toModelId}, #{fromDimension}, #{toDimension}, #{status}, #{totalCount}, #{processedCount}, #{failedCount}, #{errorMessage}, #{operator}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE reembed_job SET status = #{status}, total_count = #{totalCount}, processed_count = #{processedCount}, failed_count = #{failedCount}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, from_model_id AS fromModelId, to_model_id AS toModelId, from_dimension AS fromDimension, to_dimension AS toDimension, status, total_count AS totalCount, processed_count AS processedCount, failed_count AS failedCount, error_message AS errorMessage, operator, started_at AS startedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM reembed_job WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, from_model_id AS fromModelId, to_model_id AS toModelId, from_dimension AS fromDimension, to_dimension AS toDimension, status, total_count AS totalCount, processed_count AS processedCount, failed_count AS failedCount, error_message AS errorMessage, operator, started_at AS startedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM reembed_job ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reembed_job WHERE status IN ('pending', 'running')
